entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex, I need to start a return for some cycling shoes I recently purchased.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?
It's definitely a fit issue. I took them on one ride, and they gave me terrible blisters on my heels. I tried adjusting the cleats and wearing different socks, but they're just not right for my feet.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Comfort is key, and getting blisters is the last thing you want on a ride. Let me pull up our policy. Can I get your order number, please?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It looks like the cycling shoes were delivered 7 days ago. According to our policy, you have 90 days to make a return, so you're well within the timeframe. I can process a full refund for you right away.

That's good news, thank you. Now, since I have to go through the hassle of boxing these up and I'll need to buy a different pair, is there any way you could offer a small discount code for my next purchase with VeloFit?

I understand the inconvenience of making a return. While I can't add a promotional code to this transaction, I can confirm that the return shipping is completely free. I'm sending you a prepaid shipping label to your email on file right now.
Okay, free shipping is fair. I was just seeing if there was any flexibility. I do appreciate you approving the refund so easily.

Of course. We want to make sure you're happy. The email is on its way. Just print the label, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be issued to your original form of payment. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Alex.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope we can find you a pair of shoes that fit perfectly next time. Have a great day.
